scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && node dist/scripts/build.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.check: npm run build && node dist/scripts/validate-architecture.js && npm run test:unit && playwright test && npm run format:check
scripts.format: prettier --write packages tests examples scripts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json .prettierrc.json CONTRIBUTING.md docs/08-code-map.md README.md AGENTS.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages tests examples scripts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json .prettierrc.json CONTRIBUTING.md docs/08-code-map.md README.md AGENTS.md
